title: Food Tour of Golden by Ebike
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
This ~18-mile e-bike tour is a relaxed, scenic way to experience Golden and the Clear Creek corridor, combining easy riding with great food, drinks, and mountain-town views. We start in the Lakota Hills neighborhood and roll through town into Clear Creek Canyon, where the path follows rushing water, red rock walls, and shaded cottonwoods before looping back into Golden.

Along the way, the ride isn’t just about the route—it’s about the stops. We’ll refuel at riverside patios like The Eddy Taproom & Hotel, continue to the lively Golden Mill with its food hall vibe and mountain views, and finish downtown at Wrigley’s Chicago Grill for pizza, sliders, and dessert if anyone wants to wrap things up sweet.

It’s an easygoing ride designed for sightseeing as much as cycling—mixing foothill scenery, creekside paths, North and South Table Mountain backdrops, and a steady flow of casual stops that make the miles feel light and the experience memorable.
